evals.name: foundry-default-untitled-ui
evals.prompt: I exported a prototype from Claude as a zip — it's at "/Users/quintinhenry/Documents/Projects/FOUNDRY_SCOPE_CURRENT/Foundry Scope - Prototype.zip". Turn it into a real component library with Storybook so my team can build on it. Cover every component in the design and show the pages too.
evals.expected_output: A Bun workspace monorepo with a tokens package (source tokens.css copied verbatim + generated Tailwind v4 @theme layer), a UI library package containing all ~13 exported primitives (+ promoted form controls + Shell/Sidebar/TopBar) as typed React/TS components in the Untitled UI authoring idiom, a per-component .stories.tsx for each, and a Storybook app (v10 + @tailwindcss/vite) with all 8 pages rebuilt as full-viewport stories and a dark-default [data-theme] toggle.

assertions.text: A Bun workspace root package.json exists with a "workspaces" array (packages/*, apps/*)

A component-library package exists with one source file per exported primitive (Button, Badge, Card, Progress, StatusDot, Avatar, FileIcon, ConfidencePip, FindingTypePill, CodeBlock, SectionHeader, Kbd, Overline)
The source tokens.css is copied verbatim (preserving :root + [data-theme=dark] + [data-theme=light]) AND a tailwind-theme.css with an @theme block was generated
Each library component has a co-located stories file (*.stories.tsx)
Storybook is configured with .storybook/main.ts (framework @storybook/react-vite, @tailwindcss/vite wired) and preview.ts importing the token CSS
A dark-default light/dark theme toggle is wired via [data-theme] (withThemeByDataAttribute or equivalent)
All 8 source pages (list, wizard, overview, upload, analyze, review, codebase, report) are rebuilt as Storybook stories composed from the ported components
Components reference semantic token utilities (e.g. bg-accent / text-fg), not hard-coded hex values, so theming works
bun install completed (a bun.lock / lockfile is present) [full-depth runs only]
The project type-checks or builds: tsc --noEmit passes or build-storybook succeeds [full-depth runs only]

evals.name: svelte-framework-flag
evals.prompt: Take this Claude design export ("/Users/quintinhenry/Documents/Projects/FOUNDRY_SCOPE_CURRENT/Foundry Scope - Prototype.zip") and build a Svelte component library plus Storybook from it. Use Svelte, not React. --framework svelte
evals.expected_output: Same monorepo shape, but the library components are Svelte 5 runes components (.svelte with $props), Storybook uses @storybook/svelte-vite, tokens are carried over with the [data-theme] toggle preserved, and pages are rebuilt as Svelte stories.

assertions.text: Library components are .svelte files using Svelte 5 runes ($props), not React/.tsx
Storybook is configured for Svelte (@storybook/svelte-vite framework)
All exported primitives from the design are present as Svelte components
The source tokens.css is carried over and a [data-theme] dark/light toggle is wired
Tailwind v4 utilities (semantic token classes) are used for styling the components
The design's pages are rebuilt as Svelte page stories

evals.name: custom-lean-react-page-subset
evals.prompt: From the design zip at "/Users/quintinhenry/Documents/Projects/FOUNDRY_SCOPE_CURRENT/Foundry Scope - Prototype.zip", build a lean plain-React component library — I don't want Untitled UI or React Aria, just simple typed components with Tailwind. And in Storybook I only need the report and review pages, not all of them. --library custom --pages report,review
evals.expected_output: Monorepo with a custom-React library: components use a small cn() helper (clsx + tailwind-merge) and native elements, with NO react-aria-components dependency. All primitives present with stories. Only the report and review pages are rebuilt as page stories.

assertions.text: The UI package has a cn()/clsx + tailwind-merge helper and does NOT depend on react-aria-components
All exported primitives are present as typed React/TS components
Only the report and review pages are rebuilt as page stories (not the other 6 pages)
Components use literal-union props derived from the source's variant/size keys
A Storybook (react-vite + tailwind v4) is configured with the component + the two page stories

evals.name: ultracode-parallel-waves
evals.prompt: Here's the Claude design export at "/Users/quintinhenry/Documents/Projects/FOUNDRY_SCOPE_CURRENT/Foundry Scope - Prototype.zip" — build the component library with Storybook.
evals.expected_output: Same deliverable as the default eval, but produced via the ultracode wave protocol: a main-thread golden reference port + conventions.md contract, dependency-wave fan-out of component-porter agents (full fan-out within each wave), tsc gates between waves, a parallel page wave, and a library-reconciler sweep before final verification.

assertions.text: The most-used primitive is ported in the main thread FIRST and a conventions.md contract is written before any fan-out
Remaining components are dispatched to parallel component-porter subagents in dependency waves (leaf primitives before compound components before composites), full fan-out within each wave
A tsc --noEmit gate runs between waves; failures are fixed or re-dispatched before the next wave
Pages are rebuilt by a simultaneous page wave of porter agents composing only ported library exports
A library-reconciler sweep runs at the start of Phase 8 and idiom drift (casing, stray inline var(--x), one-off class helpers) is fixed or reported
The main thread does not bulk-port components itself outside the golden reference and failure takeovers
